summary: Outputs frame, rate, range, BPM, signature, and play-state channels from a component's Time COMP or a referenced timecode source.
key_concepts: Timeline CHOP outputs time-based CHOP channels for a specific component timeline.
When Reference Operator is blank, it uses the time at the Timeline CHOP's own location, equivalent to `me.time`.
When Reference Operator is set, the referenced node's Time COMP supplies the timeline values.
Use Timecode switches the time source to a Timecode object, CHOP, or DAT while the reference operator still supplies BPM, signature, start, and end values.
The operator can output frame, rate, start/end, range start/end, time signature, BPM, and play-state channels.
Component-local time can differ from root/project time, so explicit references are safer for reusable components.

key_params.name: op
key_params.note: Reference operator whose Time COMP is used

key_params.name: usetimecode
key_params.note: Use a timecode reference for time values

common_gotchas: When no Reference Operator is set, Timeline CHOP uses the time at its own location, equivalent to me.time.
When Use Timecode is enabled, the timecode reference supplies time while the reference operator still supplies BPM, signature, start, and end values.
The Timecode reference can be a CHOP, DAT first-cell string, or Timecode object.
Use this for timeline metadata; use Timecode CHOP for conversion/generation workflows.
Component-local time can differ from root/project time, so explicit references are safer in reusable components.
